create_CacheDeletionMigration: create a CacheDeletionMigration to delete cache entries of a specific kind from MongoDB
create_QueueDeletionMigration: create a QueueDeletionMigration to delete jobs of a specific type from the MongoDB queue
create_MigrationQueueDeleteTTLIndex: create a MigrationQueueDeleteTTLIndex to delete a TTL index on a field in the jobs collection
create_MigrationDeleteIndex: create a MigrationDeleteIndex to delete a named index from a specified MongoDB collection
create_MigrationRemoveFieldFromJob: create a MigrationRemoveFieldFromJob to remove a specified field from all job documents
